Inline code in replies is drawn in the theme's accent color again, so replies no longer read as all one gray.

- Since 0.78.0, inline code on a gray chip used the body text color, which left most replies with no color at all. The text inside the chip now uses the theme's `claude` accent color; the chip stays gray. Links keep their own color and underline
- Inline code drawn without a chip (when the background fill is off) also uses the accent color instead of the `error` color, which looked like an error
- desk-asana and desk-slack panes draw inline code the same way. desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.80.1 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
